note: regime -> violation-type -> fine formula/cap, grounded in real public enforcement notices. Feeds the platform FAIR engine's loss-magnitude (lm) input directly -- deliberately not force-fit into OSCAL, which models controls/assessment rather than fine schedules.

uk-gdpr.statute: UK GDPR / Data Protection Act 2018 s157

higher-tier.description: Arts 5, 6, 7, 9, 44-49 breaches -- unlawful processing, core principles, cross-border transfers

real_examples_gbp.source: ICO monetary penalty notice, 4 Apr 2023 -- children's data

pci-dss.statute: Visa/Mastercard operating regulations, non-compliance assessment schedule

non-compliance-escalating.description: escalating monthly non-compliance assessment while a merchant remains PCI DSS non-compliant after a confirmed breach

real_examples_gbp.note: figures are the widely cited Visa/Mastercard non-compliance fine bands, not a single named enforcement case -- card-scheme fines are contractual and rarely disclosed by org name

hipaa.authority: US HHS Office for Civil Rights (OCR)

willful-neglect-uncorrected.description: Tier 4 -- willful neglect, not corrected within 30 days

systems-and-controls-failure.description: AML / systems-and-controls breaches -- no fixed statutory cap, driven by relevant revenue and seriousness

formula.note: step 2 disgorgement + step 3 seriousness (% of relevant revenue) + step 4/5 deterrence & adjustment/discount; no fixed cap

real_examples_gbp.source: FCA final notice, 9 Apr 2019 -- AML controls
FCA final notice, 20 Dec 2022 -- IT migration failures
